Notes:
• TEST BUILD for upgrading from 0.3.0 and recovering back to 0.3.0 through the selected-build menu.
• Changes from 0.3.0: version metadata and this test-build release history only.
• Ping, Traceroute, TCP Port Test, update/recovery implementation and schema-1 settings are unchanged.
• Unsigned installers require acknowledgement; Windows permission prompts remain enabled.

• Added a published-build selector and one action to install, reinstall or recover the chosen version.
• Verify GitHub installer identity, SHA-256, size, product version and Windows trust; unsigned builds require acknowledgement.
• Stop diagnostics, preserve versioned settings backups and restart through an isolated helper.
• Keep Windows permission prompts and manual release links; no background installation.

• Added TCP Port Test with independent endpoint polling, pause/resume, templates, connection history and CSV export.
• Added manual GitHub Releases checks, release notes and a manual recovery guide.
• Moved Settings and Updates to the bottom application group in the sidebar.

• Introduced real multi-target ICMP Live Ping and continuous TTL-based ICMP Traceroute.
• Added CIDR input, named address templates, trace address history and independent trace sessions.
• Improved independent scheduling, bounded DNS/probe workers and UI update batching.
• Added compact probe settings, result timestamps, configurable columns, fit/resize guides and stable history scrolling.
• Corrected maximized window bounds and introduced minimal window controls.
• Added .NET 10 Windows self-contained publishing and the Inno Setup installer foundation.
